answer.text: Risk-free rate + risk premium for bearing risk

explanation.text: The Logic: Required return = Risk-free + Risk premium (for bearing the investment's risks). The Trap: Single-component definitions are inadequate. Cross-Exam Context: Core CAPM concept in XV, X-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Anchor discount rates in current 10-year G-Sec yield + 5-6% equity risk premium.
